ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires IOPA section HIDDEN for pure Conventional Full Arch (All on 4/6/X) — only OPG should render. Current code at [id].tsx:123 `needsIopa = iopaImplantPositions.length > 0` returns true because full-arch positions like 14/16/26 are still Conventional, so both OPG (via isFullArch) AND IOPA sections render. Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase4-step2/[id].tsx:120-123.

integration_issues.flow: Phase 4 Step 2 submit payload for pure Conventional Full Arch
integration_issues.issue: Because the section renders, submit payload includes `iopa_uploads: {...}` for the full-arch case, but spec says `iopa_uploads: null, opg_upload: {...}` for pure-Conv-non-full-arch → implies full-arch Conv should send only opg_upload and NOT iopa_uploads. Fix by narrowing needsIopa: e.g. `needsIopa = iopaImplantPositions.length > 0 && (zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0 || !isFullArch)`. Also update the OPG-missing message: pureConvFA scenario currently shows title 'Post-Delivery OPG *' (no Zygoma/Pterygoid suffix) which is correct, but the validation copy at [id].tsx:246 already handles this branch — no change needed there.

action_items: Fix pure Conventional Full Arch imaging split at /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase4-step2/[id].tsx:123 — narrow needsIopa so it is FALSE when isFullArch is TRUE and zygPtrImplantPositions.length === 0. Recommended: `const needsIopa = iopaImplantPositions.length > 0 && (zygPtrImplantPositions.length > 0 || !isFullArch);`. This will hide the IOPA section and null out iopa_uploads in the submit payload for pure Conv full-arch (All on 4/6/X) cases as required by the spec.

After the fix, verify: (a) pureConvFA renders `phase4-step2-opg-section` only, no `phase4-step2-iopa-section`; (b) submit payload sends `iopa_uploads: null, opg_upload: {...}`; (c) missing-hints panel no longer shows an IOPA count for pureConvFA; (d) other 8 scenarios continue to behave as measured (pureConv IOPA-only, pureZyg/purePtr/pureQuadZyg/zygPtr OPG-only, mixedZygConv/mixedPtrConv/mixedFull BOTH with Conv-only IOPA rows).

OPTIONAL — RadiographCompare full-arch mode currently renders on pureConvFA (row `compare-row-Full Arch — OPG`). Spec Ask 1.1 explicitly names All on 4/6/X under Conventional cases, so this is correct; retained for reference.

rca_of_issue: PureConvFA IOPA-visibility bug: When implant_procedure_type ∈ {All on 4, All on 6, All on X} AND every position is Conventional (no ZR/ZL/PR/PL), the spec requires ONLY the OPG section (full-arch OPG behavior). The current implementation partitions implant positions correctly (iopaImplantPositions = all Conv, zygPtrImplantPositions = []), then sets needsOpg=true (via isFullArch) and needsIopa=true (via iopaImplantPositions.length > 0). The bug is that `needsIopa` doesn't consider full-arch context. Reproduction: (1) Set procedure implant_procedure_type='All on 4' + implant_plans=[{position:'14'},{position:'16'},{position:'26'}]; (2) Open /procedures/submit-phase4-step2/{id}; (3) Observe both `phase4-step2-opg-section` and `phase4-step2-iopa-section` rendered. Mitigation: narrow needsIopa as noted above. Downstream: fixes the payload branch at line 277 automatically (needsIopa=false → iopa_uploads=null), and the missing-hints panel at line 643 automatically (iopaMissing=0).
